change_log.detail: List price moved from 6.80 to 7.10 per linear foot.
Cool-touch cap layer added to the 2026 run.
New listing: Ascent PVC Decking appeared on the dealer price list.
Introductory price of 7.40 raised to 7.75 per linear foot.
Dropped from 2.29 to 2.15 per square foot.
Ascent Stair Tread now lists a deeper traction emboss.
Engineered Wood Siding picked up a Class A fire rating.
New listing: Standing Seam Roof Panel added to the metal roofing page.
StormGuard roll price cut from 98.00 to 92.50.
Sentinel Impact Window added a forced-entry rating to its spec sheet.
SolarShield moved from 129.00 to 134.00 per square.
New listing: Harbor Awning Window replaced a discontinued basement unit.
Insulated Vinyl Siding backer upgraded from R-2.0 to R-2.7.
FlexBond cartridge price raised from 7.85 to 8.20.
Summit Clad delisted the 12 ft Composite Deck Board length; 16 ft and 20 ft remain.
Horizon Casement Window moved to triple pane as the standard glazing.
Shake Panel Siding moved from 3.79 to 3.95 per square foot.
IceStop Roof Membrane now advertises cold-weather application to 25F.
Fiberglass Batt R-19 cut from 1.04 to 0.98 per square foot.
New listing: Steel Lap Siding added in three new dark colors.
Blown Cellulose R-13 dropped from 0.79 to 0.74 per square foot.
Marine Sealant added a 10-year warranty to the label.
EverGrain Fascia Board discontinued in Coastal Grey; five colors remain.
GapFill Foam Sealant moved from 6.95 to 7.35 per can.
Vantage Double-Hung Window added laminated glass as a no-cost option.
